# Dataset admission
1. Re-ground on current `main`, `AGENTS.md`, `DATA_LICENSING.md` and `SCIENTIFIC_METHOD.md`.
2. Record exact provider/product/version/query and authoritative current terms evidence.
3. Evaluate access, commercial use, raw redistribution, derived redistribution, attribution, privacy and contractual conditions separately.
4. Keep unknown/stale/contradictory rights blocked.
5. Acquire bytes outside Git only after explicit authorization; bind exact source, timestamp, byte count and SHA-256.
6. Preserve transformation lineage and semantic changes. Transformation never creates broader rights.
7. Report admission state before/after, evidence, bytes added to Git (normally none), checks and blockers.
